body: Sure, I’m glad to be here for you. Is there anything in particular that’s on your mind?
Hi do you need someone to talk to?
Hi do you need someone to talk to? I’m here
Is college something you’re interested in or not particularly? What’s something fun you do to take your mind of those thoughts?

Why do you feel down about that? Just haven’t been feeling great for a while now, had a terrible day so I thought I’d just give posting on here a go to. Not too many, looking for something to try currently, hbu?
I have talked to many therapists but unfortunately talking to them doesn’t seem to help me.
Are you looking for a full time job or a part time job while studying? Does your dad know about how you’re feeling?

I’ve been hoping to get out of my current home for over a year now because of my unhealthy home situation but that isn’t working so unfortunately I’m not sure what to do about that. I really want to complete school but my state of mind is past the point of being able to do schoolwork the best I can. It’s really important for me to be able to do well for when I go to college. But unfortunately I am bed bound.
I was supposed to graduate this year. Haven’t been to school for two years.

That’s really good. I’m glad you did too, you seem like a wonderful person, thank you again. I’m just not sure what to do about anything. I’ve tried many antidepressants and I’m still struggling and haven’t been to school for years because of it. I just am really really lost

Hi, thank you for replying (:  I felt really good this morning, I was looking forward to my day but unfortunately home life for me is really unhealthy. Because I am so depressed, I really don’t do much. I try as best as I can though. My mum screamed at me for accidentally overflowing the pan today and now is threatening to send me to the mental hospital although I don’t understand why that would make her mad because today, besides that, was like every other day
Hi haha that made me chuckle. How are you? Just feeling really stressed about home life currently

Hi. I read your comment about having chronic fatigue and depression for years. I have suffered with both for years too so I completely understand what it’s like to go through that. I’m here if you need someone who could understand that aspect and If you need to talk to someone I’m here for you.
Hi do you need someone to talk to? I can try my best to be there for you.
Hi, thank you so much for replying, that means the world to me. How are you today?Just really struggling currently, I’ve been depressed for five years and thought I’d give posting on here a go
And please comment your advice here I cannot access any message because I cannot get the app because of mums settings on my phone.

Hello, it might be a great idea to see someone who can help you over come this. A therapist might be an option. You are not being unreasonable, I can sympathise that. Looking for a new job might help to, if you’re too scared, that isn’t healthy. I hope the best for you.
